sentences.text: Tapinosteus was an extinct genus containing only a single species of arthrodire placoderm.
Fossils of this creature have been found in Bad Wildungen, Germany.
The genus Tapinosteus was described by Stensiö in 1963, with the type species Tapinosteus heintzi also named by him that year.

It belongs to the family Pholidosteidae and is classified within the class Placodermi. Scientists consider it a basal member of the clade Aspinothoracidi, which is part of the larger clade Pachyosteomorphi.
Tapinosteus lived during the Late Frasnian stage of the Late Devonian period, existing between 382.31 and 372.15 million years ago.
